BG should be valid up to 60 days beyond the entire contractual obligation including warranty period of 12 months. (32 Months). Advance Payment: - Interest free mobilization advance payment of 30% of the development cost shall b e made against submission of Bank Guarantee , in favour of the Director DEBEL, Bengaluru, of 110% of adv ance payment by the prospective L1 bidder. In case of termination of the Contract/extension of delivery pe riod due to default of the Seller or where advance taken has not been/could not be used for the purpose of order execution , interest free mobilization advance would be deemed as interest bearing advance (from t he date of receipt of advance), compounded quarterly, at the rate of 2% above the MCLR (Marginal Cost of Funds based Lending Rate) declared by RBI pertaining to SBI for Indian Seller. The rates as applicable on t he date of receipt of advance will be considered for this. Bid Security Declaration in lieu of EMD- While uploading the technical documents on GeM portal, it is r equested to participant to furnish bid security declaration in lieu of EMD. The specimen copy of the same is enclosed as ATC document. It is to be noted that in case Bid security declaration is not received on “tender bid opening date and time”, bid of such participants will summarily be rejected. Local Content: Only bidders with local content more than 20% (Class II & Class I suppliers) are eligible to participate in the bid. All prospective participants are requested to kindly furnish the percentage of local c ontent & address of Value Addition as enclosed format in ATC document. It is to be noted that non-submiss ion of the local content certificate will lead to the disqualification of the particular bid. In this regard a certi ficate has to be submitted by the bidder. The Specimen copy of the same is enclosed at ATC. Restriction of participation from bidders from a country sharing land border with India : Bidders are required to provide a certificate as per the provision of Govt. Public procurement Order No. F.No.6/18/ 2019-PPD dated 23/7/2020, as amended. The format of the certificate is enclosed at ATC. Considering this tender enabled with two packets (separately for technical bid and price bid), submission o f price bid along with technical bid is strictly prohibited and such bids shall be summarily rejected . 7.
